desc: INDEPENDENT REVIEW PASS 2026-07-24: m1n1 d4f13a62b626 builds separate exact J614s right-HPM2 SPMI candidates for R0/R1/R2 under scripts/t6040-build-hpm2-candidates.sh. The reviewer independently reproduced all hashes from two clean builds per class. Runtime gate checks captured ADT size+CRC plus exact board/controller/sole-child/SID/rid/right-port properties; strict transport bounds RX/FIFO/selector/command waits, rejects leftover RX, and logs raw response headers/data before validation. It directly addresses only nub-spmi-a1/hpm2. R0 links no WAKEUP or extended write; R1 adds WAKEUP+conditional SSPS S0; R2 adds IntMask1 0x16 nine-byte zero-mask verify and byte-exact original restore, with no W1C clear. From the first temporary-write attempt, R2 assumes the write may have landed even on a lost/malformed response and always attempts restore. RESET/SLEEP/SHUTDOWN, generic HPM/TPS iteration, USB/PHY bring-up, and long transfers are absent from linked candidates. Artifacts: linux-build-out/t6040-hpm2-d4f13a62b626. Review makes only R0/093 eligible; R1/R2 remain dependency-gated. Offline only; no rig touched.
